title: Bottle Listing From One Photo
tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

faults.what: The supposed lid-detail image repeats the original full-bottle photo, including the wooden table and room, rather than providing a close-up of the lid and matte surface.
The white-background bottle has stronger, glossier highlights than the reference, and the internal shape of its lid loop differs slightly, weakening exact product fidelity.

judge.summary: The white-background and gym-bench shots are presentable, but the requested close-up is missing and the white shot slightly changes the bottle's appearance.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a collage.
must_haves.why: Three individual square outputs are shown.

must_haves.item: The bottle in every image matches the attached photo's silhouette, proportions, lid and matte black finish.
must_haves.why: The overall silhouette and proportions are close, but the white-background version looks glossier and slightly changes the lid-loop interior.

must_haves.item: The white-background image shows the entire bottle with the original wooden table removed.
must_haves.why: The full bottle is visible against white, with only a soft grounding shadow and no wooden table.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench.
must_haves.why: The bottle rests on a padded gym bench with plausible contact and a blurred gym setting.

must_haves.item: The close-up clearly shows the lid and matte surface without inventing new product features.
must_haves.why: The third output is the original wide product photo rather than a close-up.

must_haves.item: No added text or branding appears.
must_haves.why: No text or branding is visible in the outputs.
